name: ambivalent_patient
description: Every fact needed to book is on file, but the patient is reluctant. Complete facts are not consent: the readiness gate must block ACT and route to a conversational move instead.

turns.content: Hi Priya, I'm Daphne. What can I help with?
My doctor mentioned colon screening. I've never had a colonoscopy.
Any family history of colon cancer or polyps?
No, no one in my family has had that.
Any bleeding, weight loss, or changes in bowel habits?
No, none of that. I feel completely fine.
You're due for screening. Would you like me to find you an appointment?
I don't know. My sister said the prep was horrible and I really don't like the idea of being sedated. Maybe I should wait a while.
